items.title: 2.9 Do dimensions mein elastic takrao (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9 with Fig. 2.15 and Example 2.9 (PDF 44-45, 49-50).

blocks.text: Jab ek axis ke saath chalte do ajsam takrao ke baad usi ibtidai axis par na chalein to yeh do-dimensional takrao ki soorat hai. Jab takrao elastic ho to ajsam ka system apna kul linear momentum aur kul kinetic energy dono baqi rakhta hai. Kisi terhe (glancing) zawiye par elastic taur par takrate do ajsam lein, taake takrao seedha (head-on) na ho. Farz karein m1 pehle jism (projectile) ka mass hai jo ibtidai velocity v1i se chalta hai, aur m2 doosre jism (target) ka mass, jo shuru mein sukoon mein hai, v2i = 0. Dono ajsam ke takrane par un ke darmiyan paida impulses unhen us x-axis se zawiyon theta1 aur theta2 par bhej dete hain jis ke saath projectile shuru mein chal raha tha (Fig. 2.15).

blocks.title: Terha (glancing) takrao
blocks.text: Do ajsam ke darmiyan aisa elastic takrao jo seedha na ho; shuru mein mass m2 wala target jism sukoon mein hai.

Takrao se pehle projectile ka ibtidai momentum m1 v1i hai, jabke target ka ibtidai momentum sifr hai. Mass m1 aur velocity v1f wale projectile ka aakhri momentum m1 v1f hai, aur mass m2 aur velocity v2f wale target ka aakhri momentum m2 v2f. Projectile ke aakhri momentum ko components m1 v1f cos theta1 aur m1 v1f sin theta1 mein, aur target ke ko m2 v2f cos theta2 aur m2 v2f sin theta2 mein torein. x-axis ke saath momentum ka baqa: pehle ka momentum = baad ka momentum, m1 v1i = m1 v1f cos theta1 + m2 v2f cos theta2, ya m1 v1i - m1 v1f cos theta1 = m2 v2f cos theta2 ... (2.34). y-axis ke saath momentum ka baqa: 0 = m1 v1f sin theta1 - m2 v2f sin theta2, ya m1 v1f sin theta1 = m2 v2f sin theta2 ... (2.35).

(1/2) m1 v1i^2 = (1/2) m1 v1f^2 + (1/2) m2 v2f^2, ya m1 v1i^2 = m1 v1f^2 + m2 v2f^2 ... (2.36). In equations ka tajziya chaar na-maloom miqdarein dikhata hai, v1f, v2f, theta1 aur theta2; agar yeh miqdarein napi ja sakein to equations (2.34), (2.35) aur (2.36) se momentum aur energy ka baqa sabit kiya ja sakta hai.

Inelastic takrao mein kinetic energy ka kuch hissa garmi, awaz aur bigaar jaisi doosri shakalon mein muntaqil hota hai: lakri ke tukre mein dagi goli awaz aur garmi ke taur par energy khoti hai, aur oonchai se farsh par girai gend usi oonchai tak wapas nahi uchhalti kyunke kinetic energy awaz aur garmi jaisi doosri shakalon mein zaya hoti hai (Interesting Information).

blocks.title: Example 2.9 (print mein 2.12 ke baad)
blocks.text: 1 kg mass ka zarra A ibtidai velocity 5 m s^-1 se daen taraf chalta hua usi mass ke sukoon mein target B se takrata hai. Takrao ke baad A ufuq se 30 degrees oopar 3 m s^-1 ki speed se aur B ufuq se 53 degrees par 4 m s^-1 ki speed se chalta hai. Sabit karein ke takrao elastic hai. Hal: ibtidai momentum = m1 v1i + m2 v2i = (1 kg x 5 m s^-1) + (1 kg x 0) = 5 kg m s^-1. x-simt mein aakhri momentum = m1 v1f cos 30 + m2 v2f cos 53 = (1 kg x 3 m s^-1 x cos 30) + (1 kg x 4 m s^-1 x cos 53) = 2.60 + 2.40 = 5 kg m s^-1, to x-simt mein momentum baqi hai. (KE)i = (1/2) x 1 x 5^2 + (1/2) x 1 x 0 = 12.5 J; (KE)f = (1/2) x 1 x 3^2 + (1/2) x 1 x 4^2 = 4.5 + 8 = 12.5 J. Chunke momentum aur kinetic energy dono baqi hain, takrao elastic hai.

blocks.caption: Terhe elastic takrao ki teen equations
rows: m1 v1i = m1 v1f cos theta1 + m2 v2f cos theta2
m1 v1f sin theta1 = m2 v2f sin theta2

blocks.prompt: Example 2.9 mein y-axis ke saath bhi momentum ka baqa jaanchein, aur batayein ke kinetic energy ko components mein torne ki zaroorat kyun nahi thi.
blocks.explanation: Baad ka y-momentum: 1 x 3 x sin 30 - 1 x 4 x sin 53 = 1.50 - 3.19 = -1.7 kg m s^-1, jo sifr nahi: chhape zawiyon ke saath y-momentum sirf taqreeban barabar hai, to chhapi misal sirf x-momentum aur energy jaanchti hai. Kinetic energy scalar hai, to speeds seedhi (1/2) m v^2 mein components ke baghair istemal hoti hain.

items: Terha elastic takrao, target sukoon mein: x-momentum m1 v1i = m1 v1f cos theta1 + m2 v2f cos theta2; y-momentum m1 v1f sin theta1 = m2 v2f sin theta2; energy m1 v1i^2 = m1 v1f^2 + m2 v2f^2; chaar na-maloom v1f, v2f, theta1, theta2.
